method: Four complete before/after A/B/B/A benchmark invocations under bench-class admission without quiet mode. A uses the baseline detector and concurrency source at the before commit and cold full version parses. B uses the optimized detector and concurrency source and bounded parent-context version parses. Both use the same final syntax-unit lookup helper, which avoids unrelated damaged-line sibling walks. Current parsing, authoring, engine application, window setup, IPC and UI are excluded. Append, exact pairs, footprints and real syntax queries are included; marked batches also include projections, projected parsing and fingerprints. Every invocation checks expected pairs and marks. Profiles include instrumentation overhead and are separate from the cost gate. Percentiles select sorted[floor(n*q)]. Raw samples and individual runs are retained below.
excludedExperiments: Earlier cold marked and ordinary tuning experiments; copied-tree incremental-only pilots (~131–140 ms marked median).

An initial final B1 failed the marked gate at 30.370251 ms: an adjacent recovery node had a missing semicolon, so an unchanged-neighbor check correctly rejected the bounded parse. The fix expands through damaged neighbors and checks the next clean boundaries; a differential regression covers it. That incomplete A1/B1 attempt and diagnostic pilots are excluded.

detector.method: 100k TypeScript lines. 100 concurrent single-character replacements, 2/4/8 authors, 100 or 8192 retained records. 60 samples per mode after 20 warmups, alternating A/B/B/A. A appends the batch and queries exact pairs. B appends the batch and runs the detector including footprint mapping and real merge-unit queries. The retained parse is prepared outside timers, as detection runs after parsing. Parent eligibility caches reset before every batch. Setup, authoring, engine application and causal-prefix preparation stay outside timers. IPC, parsing the current snapshot, and UI are excluded. No candidate marks in this independent-unit workload; version rebuilding has a separate correctness corpus.

profile.qualification: experiment, shared machine; profiling overhead included, not the cost-gate result
profile.method: Retained current parse prepared outside timing. 20 warmups, then A/B/B/A with 80 samples per mode. A: exact pairs. B: complete detector. Append separately timed in both modes. Query instrumentation calls the original real Query.matches. V8 CPU sampling at 100 microseconds starts after each window setup and stops before validation; GC/harness remain separately reported. CPU categories normalize append and pair samples across both modes to one complete batch. CPU shares are sampling estimates, not additive wall timings.
profile.reconstruction: This independent-unit batch produces no candidates: no projected snapshots, version parsing, content fingerprints or projectEffects rebuilds. The conflict corpus separately exercises reconstruction; this profile does not bound its cost.
